description: Installation view of five O'Keeffe paintings on adjacent white walls; two paintings of horse skulls, one painting of a thigh bone, one painting of a landscape, and one painting of a flower.
imageCaption: Alfred Stieglitz. Georgia O'Keeffe 33 New Paintings (New Mexico) - An American Place, Interior Gallery View, 1931 or 1932. gelatin silver print. Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation Photographs. Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe: 33 New Paintings (New Mexico), An American Place
